# Project Instructions

- Read [README.md](../README.md) for the QE agents and MCP setup, and [README.testing.md](../README.testing.md) for Playwright, API, database, and Pact workflows before making related changes.
- Inspect the relevant config and neighboring implementation before editing. Preserve existing project conventions and unrelated worktree changes.
- Do not invent application URLs, locators, credentials, API behavior, test results, or root causes. Mark unknown details clearly or ask for the missing information.
- Keep secrets out of source, prompts, reports, and logs. Do not edit environment files or generated reports unless the user asks.
- Make focused changes, update directly related docs, and run the smallest relevant validation. Report what was validated and any configuration limitation.
- The root Playwright config and CI reporter may not match the test folder or report path a task expects; inspect them before claiming a test ran or a report is fresh.
